validity.recommendation: Existence and classification of P5539 are CONFIRMED: this is a real, independently-verifiable transmission gas pipeline (OSM relation 17195756 'Пунга — Ухта — Грязовец 4', ~943 km computed length vs. the sheet's 945.80 km, 1420mm diameter, operating). The finding here is narrower: the pre-existing Fuel[ref]/PipelineType[ref]/Status[ref] citation https://zaogsp.ru/istoriya/punga is MISATTRIBUTED. Read in full (its meta title/description AND its 'Характеристика проекта' body text), the page describes a capital-repair project on a DIFFERENT physical object: 'Существующий магистральный газопровод «Пунга-Ухта-Грязовец» введен в эксплуатацию в 1976 году, входит в газотранспортную систему ООО «Газпром трансгаз Югорск» ... объект капитального ремонта расположен в Березовском районе Ханты-Мансийского автономного округа' -- i.e. a 1976-commissioned facility in Berezovsky District, Khanty-Mansi AO, operated by Gazprom Transgaz YUGORSK. That is the PUNGA-side (western/Ob-Irtysh) end of the wider colloquially-named 'Punga-Ukhta-Gryazovets' corridor -- not this row (segment IV, Ukhta-Gryazovets, Komi Republic/Vologda Oblast, 1981, operated by Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta per the Operator[ref] finding). The corridor's several stages/strings share one popular name across many decades of press and contractor use, which is exactly the trap standing corollary (a) (a ref must NAME the pipeline, not just the family/corridor) exists to catch -- and this page passed a casual read because it does name 'Пунга-Ухта-Грязовец' in its title, just not THIS segment of it. I have removed zaogsp.ru from all three fills (Fuel/PipelineType/Status) in this shard and replaced it with segment-IV-specific sources (OSM way tags for the specific way GEM's own routes repo has staged for P5539; a Wayback Vuktylskoe-LPUMG company page for Status). No change recommended to Fuel/PipelineType values (both remain correct); Status remains 'operating' on weaker (indirect) sourcing than before this pass, not stronger -- worth a further look if the researcher wants a segment-IV-specific operating-status confirmation. RECOMMEND: do not re-add zaogsp.ru/istoriya/punga to this row's refs; if it is relevant anywhere, it is most likely relevant to the Punga-Vuktyl-Ukhta family (P5540/P7538 per the in-scope roster) or an earlier-stage Punga-Ukhta segment, not P5539.

validity.recommendation: RouteAccuracy is likely OVERSTATED. The geojson currently staged in GOIT-GGIT-pipeline-routes for P5539 (local mirror checked directly; scripts/fetch_route.sh is broken -- 'AUTH_HEADER[@]: unbound variable', a pre-existing script bug not fixed here, out of scope) is a SINGLE LineString of 131 points, ~135 km, running from Ukhta (53.76,63.67) to a point ~130km southwest (51.93,62.85) -- it is exactly ONE of THIRTEEN member ways of the cited OSM relation 17195756 ('Punga-Ukhta-Gryazovets 4'), whose full 13-way length computes (haversine, by hand, via the relation's /full.json) to ~943.0 km -- matching the sheet's recorded 945.80 km length within 0.3%. So: the recorded LENGTH is well corroborated at the full-route level, but the STAGED GEOMETRY covers only ~14% of that route and terminates deep in Komi Republic, nowhere near Gryazovets (Vologda Oblast). Yet RouteAccuracy='high' and RouteType='Mapped route (at any accuracy)' are recorded as if the full route were mapped. This is the OK_INTERIOR / partial-trace pattern flagged in the batch brief: the staged geometry IS a genuine, correctly-placed fragment of the real pipeline (not a wrong/sibling trace), it just doesn't span the full recorded termini. RECOMMEND: downgrade RouteAccuracy to reflect partial coverage (proposing 'low (subnational, imprecise, or unranked)' pending a redigitize, since only a small interior fragment of the true corridor is currently mapped) and stage a route candidate for §8 (redigitize the full relation 17195756, all 13 ways, ~943km, matching Ukhta->Gryazovets) rather than editing any state/location cell -- the recorded Start/End locations themselves are correct (see the Location[ref] fill).

validity.recommendation: FuelSource='Medvezhye Oil and Gas Field' is WEAKLY sourced and in tension with an alternative implied by this pipeline's own historical naming. The current ref (proektirovanie.gazprom.ru Medvezhye field page, read via Wayback) documents the earlier 'Medvezhye-Nadym-Punga' pipeline delivering Medvezhye gas as far as Punga by October 1974 -- it never mentions Ukhta, Gryazovets, or any 1981-vintage line, i.e. it supports the WESTERN end of the wider corridor's gas origin story, not specifically this 1981 Ukhta-Gryazovets extension. Independently, siyanie-severa.ru's historical account explicitly names the pipeline commissioned April 1981 as the corridor's 4th stage 'Уренгой - Ухта - Грязовец' (Urengoy-Ukhta-Gryazovets) -- i.e., by that source's naming, fed by URENGOY field gas, not Medvezhye. Neither source is dispositive on its own (the Medvezhye ref doesn't name this segment; the Urengoy naming is inferred from a corridor's historical stage-name rather than a direct 'sourced from Urengoy field' statement), so this is flagged as CONTESTED rather than resolved in either direction. RECOMMEND: a researcher weigh whether FuelSource should read Urengoy (matching the pipeline's own 1981 commissioning-era name) instead of, or in addition to, Medvezhye, or whether corroborating that gas from BOTH fields transited this corridor (plausible for a Unified Gas Supply System trunk line carrying commingled gas from multiple West Siberian/Komi fields) makes the current single-field attribution an oversimplification either way.

validity.recommendation: Minor, informational naming tension -- not recommended for any sheet edit, documented so a future pass does not re-discover it as new. THREE sources give three different labels for what appears to be the same 1981-commissioned Ukhta-Gryazovets line: (1) OSM relation 17195756 (the source GEM's own routes repo draws from) names it 'Пунга — Ухта — Грязовец 4' (segment/stage 4 = GEM's 'IV', matching this row's segment_name and OtherLanguagePrimaryPipelineName); (2) siyanie-severa.ru's historical account calls the 1981-commissioned 4th stage of the wider 'Север-Центр' system 'Уренгой — Ухта — Грязовец' (Urengoy-Ukhta-Gryazovets), with the corridor's 3rd stage (Dec 1977) called 'Пунга — Ухта — Торжок' (Punga-Ukhta-Torzhok); (3) Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta's own 2023 company-newspaper history timeline places, under the year 1981, the commissioning of 'Пунга – Ухта – Грязовец III' -- i.e. the OPERATING COMPANY's own archive calls the 1981 line 'III', not 'IV'. All three sources agree on the 1981 date and the physical Ukhta-Gryazovets routing; they disagree only on the ordinal label and which upstream city (Punga vs Urengoy) to prefix. This is very plausibly just inconsistent popular/company usage of an internal Soviet 'queue' numbering system across nearly 50 years of sources, not evidence of a different physical pipeline -- but it is close enough to the kind of confusion that produces real duplicate-PID errors elsewhere in this roster that it is worth a second researcher's eyes. No PID, PipelineType, or existence change recommended.
